core_problem_solved: To provide a modern, Java-optimized API for building and manipulating XML documents in memory, as an easier-to-use alternative to the standard W3C DOM.
key_features: A redesigned API with full support for Java generics
Improved performance and a more robust and correct object model compared to its predecessor
Enhanced namespace handling and XPath integration
era_and_niche: The modern version of the JDOM XML processing library. It is the official and direct successor to the original `org.jdom:jdom`.
reason_for_obsolescence: While it is the current and maintained version of JDOM, the library itself is often considered a **legacy choice** for new projects. The broader trend in the Java ecosystem has moved away from programmatic DOM manipulation in favor of data-binding approaches (JAXB, Jackson-XML) or has shifted to JSON as the primary data format altogether.
